name: Fungus & Bread Gruel
instructions: Combine fungus and bread in a pot with water. Boil until mushy. Serve lukewarm.

name: Radroach Skewers
instructions: Skewer radroach meat and wild herbs. Cook over an open flame until crispy. Best served with a side of caution.

name: Nuka-Cola Quantum Surprise
instructions: Mix Nuka-Cola Quantum with crushed Sugar Bombs. Garnish with irradiated fruit. Warning: May cause glowing.

name: Wasteland Stew
instructions: Dice mystery meat and root vegetables. Boil in purified water with salt until tender. Don't ask what the mystery meat is.

name: Scorpion Pepper Surprise
instructions: Fry scorpion tail and hot peppers in cooking oil. Guaranteed to clear your sinuses and possibly your digestive tract.
